description: Get a price quote for a paid rental of a specific domain for a given duration. Returns the computed rental cost, tier info, and pricing breakdown. Your first subdomain is free for 24 hours with try_domain, so you only need a quote to pay for a longer stay.

domainId.description: The domain to price: its id from search_domains, or its name (for example addedtocart.shop)

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration: PT1H (1 hour), PT4H (4 hours), P1D (1 day), P7D (1 week), P30D (30 days)

name: get_price_quote
